reason: All 8 files in the patch are Java and none touches docs/, release notes or upgrade notes. It also does not say that getFederatedCredentialsStream is read first and its result is fed to createFromCredentialModel (RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.java:101-106, RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator.java:80-84), or that marking a code as used is left to the provider's isValid.
